question: Under what condition does poison fail to enter the body, even in the case of a bite?
premises: Poison is the thing in question.
A person may be bitten by great serpents.
Even in that case, poison does not enter the body.
inference: Even if bitten by great serpents, poison does not enter the body.
uncertainties: The reason for poison failing to enter is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one is bitten by great serpents.
